text:
maddie: Kicking off int4 bring-up for Tangent9b. FP16 baseline passes, int4 conversion shows ~6pt ROUGE-L regression on summarization and occasional repeated spans for long-context tests. Uploaded logs + traces.

vikram: Share convert command and one failing sample please.

maddie: Converter cmd: `python convert_model.py --src tangent9b-fp16 --dst tangent9b-int4 --quant int4_sym --head-layout=auto --rotary-scale=1.0 --export-kv`
Failing sample: `prompt_hash=0x7c1a rouge-l=0.385 baseline=0.46 repeat=true`

ola: auto head-layout is suspicious for Tangent family; many exporters use interleaved head ordering. If we guessed contiguous, rotary/KV indices can misalign.

zane: Quick kv-diff shows offsets starting ~step 180: `avg_offset=0.14 max_offset=1`.

sam: Also check exporter vocab conventions: we once had a 1-based vs 0-based manifest bug. Try vocab_shift=-1 as a quick check.

maddie: vocab_shift=-1 -> avg_offset 0.03, but ROUGE still down ~3.5 pts. I observed small rotary sin/cos perturbations (layer6.head3 delta ~0.0017) after quant.

vikram: int4_sym can amplify small rotary noise. Try int4_asym_adaptive + per-channel calib on attention outproj. Consider keeping sin/cos in fp16 (rotary_fp16) as a mixed-precision heuristic.

infra-bot: artifacts uploaded -> s3://redwood-onboard/tangent9b/4890012345/ (convert.log, eval_samples.jsonl, kv_trace.parquet)

ola: Add a kvcache smoke: run 3 repeats at longctx=8192 and compare logits at steps 256/512/1024 to see when drift accumulates.

zane: I added `tools/kv_compare.py` in my fork to compute per-step token-id and logit L2 diffs; usage in the bucket README.

maddie: Ran int4_asym + head-permute remap + rotary_fp16 + per-channel calib for outproj. Early results: avg_offset 0.01, rouge-l improved 0.455 (baseline 0.46). Much closer but small gap remains. kv_compare snippet: `step256 offset=0 l2=0.0021 step512 offset=0 l2=0.0030`.

sam: If mixed-precision rotary closes quality without large perf regression, add a conversion-profile flag `rotary_fp16=true` and document perf tradeoffs. Also consider skipping quant on tiny tensors (layernorm scales).

eva: I'll open an onboarding ticket, mark `onhold` for Dedicated promotion until we get <1.5pt ROUGE delta on the regression set. Adding failing prompts to Redwood Optimize.

maddie: Will run mixed-precision + skip-small-tensors experiments and post final numbers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
